reason: Obsolete/over-engineered: plan-retrospective is not a framework default (opt-in only via OPTIONAL_BUNDLE_FINALIZE_STEPS), is already scope-gated to drop on surgical/single_module (_apply_scope_gated_finalize), and only runs in this repo via the .plan/marshal.json:77 opt-in we own — which fires it on multi_module+ plans, exactly where the lesson concedes it is valuable. The proposed default/gating machinery duplicates the existing scope gate; the only remaining lever is a config line. No structural change warranted.
